hero.title:
One Question. Nineteen Sources.
One Second.
hero.description: Ask anything about your business and get a cited answer before you finish your coffee.

intro: When you ask 'what did we discuss about the Johnson project?' — HABOS doesn't search one app. It searches meeting transcripts, project notes, email threads, CRM timeline, task comments, and chat messages simultaneously. A company using separate tools for each of these — Notion, HubSpot, Gmail, Slack, Asana — would need to search five products and mentally synthesize the results. HABOS returns a ranked, citation-backed answer in under a second.
